Run `handler` on a left-click of the tray icon. While any handler is
registered, the tray's declared action does not run. Returns an unsubscribe function.

members.summary: Replace the tray icon with a bundled resource.
members.description: Replace the tray icon with a bundled resource.

members.summary: Replace the tray's dropdown menu.
members.description: Replace the tray's dropdown menu. A picked item runs its `onClick`.

members.summary: Set the text beside the icon (macOS).
members.description: Set the text beside the icon (macOS). Empty clears it.

members.summary: Show the tray item.
members.description: Show the tray item.

members.summary: Image and video information, compression, preview and saving to the library.
members.description: Image and video information, compression, preview and saving to the library.

members.summary: Re-encode an image as JPEG at a lower quality or size, writing a new temporary file.
members.description: Re-encode an image as JPEG at a lower quality or size, writing a new temporary file.
examples: const { path } = await lx.media.compressImage(photo, { quality: 60, maxWidth: 1280 });

members.summary: Transcode a video to a smaller file.
members.description:
Transcode a video to a smaller file.
Returns a task handle synchronously, so progress and cancellation can be
wired up before transcoding starts.

members.summary: Read an image's dimensions and type without decoding it into a view.
members.description: Read an image's dimensions and type without decoding it into a view.

members.summary: Show images and videos full screen.
members.description:
Show images and videos full screen. The handle comes back at once, so
listeners attach before the first event.

members.summary: Save a picture or a video to the system photo library; which one comes from the file's extension, else its leading bytes.
members.description:
Save a picture or a video to the system photo library; which one comes from
the file's extension, else its leading bytes.

throws.when: The file is neither.

members.summary: Reads local video metadata for upload preflight and presentation.
members.description:
Reads local video metadata for upload preflight and presentation.
Size, dimensions, duration, and path form the portable core. Container type,
rotation, and track-level codec/audio fields are best-effort and may be
omitted when the platform cannot determine them. The receiving service must
still validate the uploaded bytes.

members.summary: Write one frame of a video out as an image file.
members.description: Write one frame of a video out as an image file.
examples: const poster = await lx.media.videoThumbnail(clip, { positionMs: 1000, maxWidth: 480 });

members.summary: Move between pages, tabs and lxapps.
members.description: Move between pages, tabs and lxapps.

members.summary: Pop `n` pages, stopping at the root.
members.description: Pop `n` pages, stopping at the root. Resolves once the revealed page is ready.

members.summary: Push a page.
members.description:
Push a page. The handle is returned at once: `opened` settles when the
page is on screen, and rejects only when the platform cannot show it;
`result` settles when it leaves.
Replace the current page; the new page inherits its opener and pending result.
Switch tabs, open another lxapp, or open a URL in the in-app browser.
A `{ tab }` takes no params.

signatures.text: go<N extends ConfiguredPageName>(target: PageTarget<N>): PageHandle<NavResult<N>, NavMessages<N>>
go<N extends ConfiguredPageName>(target: PageTarget<N>, options: { replace: true; }): Promise<void>

throws.when: An unknown key, params over 8 KB as JSON, or ten pages already stacked (`data.reason: 'stack_full'`).
A page the app does not declare.
An undeclared tab.

members.summary: Back to the lxapp that opened this one.
members.description: Back to the lxapp that opened this one.

members.summary: Clear the stack and start at a page or tab; every discarded page's result settles canceled.
members.description: Clear the stack and start at a page or tab; every discarded page's result settles canceled.

signatures.text: reset<N extends ConfiguredPageName>(target: PageTarget<N> | TabTarget): Promise<void>

members.summary: Network status, downloads, uploads and Wi-Fi.
members.description: Network status, downloads, uploads and Wi-Fi.

members.summary: Download over HTTP(S), streamed to disk.
members.description:
Download over HTTP(S), streamed to disk. Returns the task before the
transfer starts: `result` settles once, `progress` streams, `cancel()`
aborts.
Download to a durable path under `lx://userdata`.
Download to a temporary file this lxapp owns.

signatures.text: download(url: string, options: AppDownloadOptions & { to: string; }): DownloadTask<AppPersistedDownloadResult>
signatures.returns: DownloadTask<{ uri: AppDownloadFilePath; storage: "userdata"; mimeType?: string; sizeBytes: number; }>

signatures.text: download(url: string, options?: AppDownloadOptions & { to?: undefined; }): DownloadTask<AppTempDownloadResult>
signatures.returns: DownloadTask<{ uri: AppDownloadFilePath; storage: "temp"; mimeType?: string; sizeBytes: number; }>

members.summary: Read connectivity right now: whether it is connected, its type, and addresses.
members.description: Read connectivity right now: whether it is connected, its type, and addresses.

members.summary: Upload a file over HTTP, streamed from disk.
members.description:
Upload a file over HTTP, streamed from disk. `method: 'PUT'` with
`bodyMode: 'raw'` sends the file as the whole body, as presigned
object-storage URLs expect. The task comes back before the transfer starts:
`result` settles once, `progress` streams to one consumer, `cancel()` aborts.

members.summary: Delivers the current connectivity, then each change; returns the unsubscribe fn.
members.description:
Delivers the current connectivity, then each change; returns the unsubscribe fn.
The current value is read asynchronously and skipped if a change lands first.

members.summary: Wi-Fi: scan, connect and follow the connected network.
members.description: Wi-Fi: scan, connect and follow the connected network.

members.summary: Asks the system to join a network.
members.description:
Asks the system to join a network. Resolves once the request is submitted,
not when the device has joined: `onConnected` reports that.

members.summary: The network the device is on now.
members.description: The network the device is on now.

members.summary: Scans and resolves the networks in range.
members.description: Scans and resolves the networks in range.

members.summary: Subscribes to WiFi connection events and returns the unsubscribe fn.
members.description: Subscribes to WiFi connection events and returns the unsubscribe fn.

members.summary: Starts the Wi-Fi module; call it before any other `lx.network.wifi` call, which otherwise rejects "not initialized".
members.description:
Starts the Wi-Fi module; call it before any other `lx.network.wifi` call,
which otherwise rejects "not initialized". Rejects when Wi-Fi is off.

members.summary: Stops the Wi-Fi module and its event delivery.
members.description: Stops the Wi-Fi module and its event delivery.

members.summary: Hand a URL to the OS: `https` opens the system browser, `tel:` and `mailto:` their apps.
members.description:
Hand a URL to the OS: `https` opens the system browser, `tel:` and
`mailto:` their apps.

throws.when: Not an absolute URL.
Any other scheme.

members.summary: Open a local file; its type comes from the path's extension.
members.description:
Open a local file; its type comes from the path's extension.
Use `mode: "review"` when the UX requires in-app preview; otherwise prefer
`mode: "auto"`.

members.summary: Ask the person for files, a directory, photos or videos, or a scanned code.
members.description: Ask the person for files, a directory, photos or videos, or a scanned code.

members.summary: Scans a barcode or QR code with the camera.
members.description:
Scans a barcode or QR code with the camera.
Resolves `{ status: 'canceled' }` only when the user dismisses the scanner. A
completed scan resolves `{ status: 'ok', value, format }`. A value that is an
`/lxapp/` app link also opens that lxapp; other URLs are only returned.
Rejects when scanning fails or the host returns an invalid payload.

members.summary: Ask the person for a folder; resolves `canceled` only when they dismiss the picker.
members.description:
Ask the person for a folder; resolves `canceled` only when they dismiss the picker.
The picked `path` is a read-only root that `lx.fs` reads and `lx.fs.copy`
take as `<path>/<relative>`, each segment percent-encoded; nothing outside
it resolves, including through a symlink.

platform: Android, HarmonyOS phones and tablets: no system folder picker, so only a `defaultPath` in lxapp storage works.

throws.when: No system folder picker and `defaultPath` is not in lxapp storage.

members.summary: Picks one file.
members.description:
Picks one file. Resolves `{ status: 'canceled' }` only when the user
dismisses the picker, otherwise `{ status: 'ok', files: [file] }`.

members.summary: Picks one or more files.
members.description:
Picks one or more files. Resolves `{ status: 'canceled' }` only when the
user dismisses the picker, otherwise `{ status: 'ok', files }`.

members.summary: Picks pictures and videos from the library, or captures one with the camera.
members.description:
Picks pictures and videos from the library, or captures one with the camera.
Library items are copied to temp on mobile; desktop returns the user's file.
Resolves `{ status: 'canceled' }` only when the user dismisses the picker. A
completed selection resolves `{ status: 'ok', files }` with at least one
file. Rejects when capture or selection fails, or the host returns an invalid
payload.

members.summary: Hand content to the system share sheet.
members.description:
Hand content to the system share sheet.
Share text, files, or a page link — files cannot be combined with a page
target or with text; share those separately.

members.summary: The desktop shell: running apps, declared surfaces, builtins and sidebar actions.
members.description: The desktop shell: running apps, declared surfaces, builtins and sidebar actions.

members.summary: Bring the product window forward without navigating.
members.description: Bring the product window forward without navigating. Control app only.

members.summary: The handle of an lxapp live as a surface of its own, declared or not; `undefined` when it is not.
The handle of a live declared surface, or of its keyed instance, the same object on every call; `undefined` when it is not live.
members.description:
The handle of a live declared surface, or of its keyed instance, the same
object on every call; `undefined` when it is not live. A declaration that
shows an lxapp answers with that app's `AppSurface`.

signatures.text: getDeclared(id: string, key?: string): DeclaredSurface | AppSurface | undefined

members.summary: Open a host builtin page such as downloads.
members.description: Open a host builtin page such as downloads. Control app only.

members.summary: Change the name and icon the host shows for the calling app.
members.description:
Change the name and icon the host shows for the calling app. Only the
Control app may call this API. Resolves once stored; the host repaints only
when a value changed, so calling it on every launch is cheap.

members.summary: The action rows the desktop sidebar shows for this lxapp.
members.description: The action rows the desktop sidebar shows for this lxapp.

members.summary: Remove one action and its callback.
members.description: Remove one action and its callback. Control app only.

throws.when: No action with this `id`.

members.summary: Replace every desktop sidebar action at once; `[]` clears them.
members.description:
Replace every desktop sidebar action at once; `[]` clears them. A refused
list leaves the previous one showing. The shell runs each action's callback
and infers nothing else. Control app only; call it on every Logic launch,
since the list does not outlive the process.

throws.when: A duplicate or empty id, more than two header actions, or more than two footer values.

members.summary: Change one action's icon, label, value or disabled state at once; its callback and placement stay.
members.description:
Change one action's icon, label, value or disabled state at once; its
callback and placement stay. A present `value` of `undefined`, `null` or `''`
clears it. Control app only.

throws.when: An empty patch or an unknown field.
No action with this `id`.

members.summary: Open this lxapp's store with every key's shape pinned on the handle.
members.description:
Open this lxapp's store with every key's shape pinned on the handle.
`get` / `set` / `delete` then share that schema instead of
repeating `get<T>()` at each call site.
Open this lxapp's asynchronous persistent key-value store. `get` asserts the
value shape at the call site and resolves `undefined` for a missing key. Use
`lx.fs` instead for path-based data.

members.summary: Frozen feature support, not permission or current layout.
members.description:
Frozen feature support, not permission or current layout. Unknown strings
return false; non-strings throw TypeError. Required features also need an
appropriate lxapp.json minRuntime.

members.summary: Open pages, apps and URLs as floats, windows, asides and tabs.
members.description: Open pages, apps and URLs as floats, windows, asides and tabs.

members.summary: Find a live surface by its explicit caller-owned key.
members.description: Find a live surface by its explicit caller-owned key. Runtime ids are not keys.

members.summary: Show another lxapp in a shell slot.
members.description: Show another lxapp in a shell slot. Control app only.

members.summary: Open a surface `lingxia.yaml` declares.
members.description:
Open a surface `lingxia.yaml` declares. Without options it opens with the declaration's own
placement; `key`, `as` and `edge` change shared shell composition and are
the Control app's.

signatures.text: openDeclared(id: string, options?: OpenDeclaredOptions): Promise<DeclaredSurface | AppSurface>

members.summary: Open one of this lxapp's pages as a float or a window.
members.description:
Open one of this lxapp's pages as a float or a window. Returns at once;
await `.opened` to wait for the page.

signatures.text: openPage<N extends ConfiguredPageName>(page: N, ...options: OpenPageArgs<N>): PageSurface<NavResult<N>, NavMessages<N>>

throws.when: Malformed options.
`as: 'window'` where the host has no windows.
A page the app does not declare.

members.summary: Open a URL in the in-app browser, as a main tab or docked as an aside.
members.description: Open a URL in the in-app browser, as a main tab or docked as an aside.

members.summary: Dialogs, action sheets and toasts.
members.description: Dialogs, action sheets and toasts.

members.summary: Shows a list of actions.
members.description:
Shows a list of actions.
Resolves `{ status: 'ok', id }` when the user selects an item; `id` identifies the selected item. Resolves `{ status: 'canceled' }` only when the
user dismisses the sheet. Rejects when presentation fails or the host returns
an invalid selection.

members.summary: Acknowledgement-only dialog.
members.description: Acknowledgement-only dialog. Resolves when the user dismisses it.

members.summary: Ask a yes/no question.
members.description: Ask a yes/no question. Dismissal resolves false; presentation failure rejects.

members.summary: Show a short message over the page.
members.description: Show a short message over the page. Returns at once; a newer toast replaces it.

members.summary: Read why an open was refused, or `null` when it failed for another reason.
Leave, with `value` as the opener's result.
members.description:
Leave, with `value` as the opener's result. A pushed page goes back; a
surface page closes its surface. Throws for a root or tab page, or a
pushed page that is not on top, and while `setup` runs.

types.name: AutostartApi
types.summary: Launch-at-startup control for the host app.
types.description:
Launch-at-startup control for the host app.
Wherever the host cannot register a startup item every call fails
`E_NOT_SUPPORTED`; ask first:
```ts
if (lx.supports('app.autostart')) {
// render the "Launch at startup" toggle
}
```
Requires `capabilities.autostart: true` in `lingxia.yaml`; without it
`lx.supports` says no on all platforms. Declaring the capability never enables
autostart by itself — the SDK registers the app only when `setEnabled(true)`
is called, so the decision stays with the user (typically a settings-page
toggle, default off).
Host-app-level capability: like `checkUpdate` and `screenshot`, the methods
are available only to the native-assigned Control app; other lxapps receive
a permission error.

fields.name: isEnabled
fields.summary: Whether the app is registered to launch at startup, read from the OS each time; the user can change it outside the app, so re-read it when the settings screen shows.
fields.description:
Whether the app is registered to launch at startup, read from the OS

platform: macOS: login items. Windows: the `Run` registry key.

types.name: BannerApi
types.summary: Product-drawn desktop banner, top-right.
types.description:
Product-drawn desktop banner, top-right. Not an OS notification and
not bound to App Link. Desktop only, in every lxapp: elsewhere every
call fails `E_NOT_SUPPORTED`, so ask `lx.supports('app.banner')` first.
A guest lxapp's banner carries its name and icon, so
it cannot pass as the product's. Its ids are its own, it may have
three banners showing or waiting, each closes after 60s at most
(`timeoutMs` is capped), and the product's banners go first.
No buttons: an informational card that auto-dismisses (5s unless
`timeoutMs` is set). With buttons: a gate that waits for a choice,
dismiss, timeout, or replace. User outcomes resolve; presentation
failures reject.

the generated `app.json`. Missing `env` is treated as `'prod'`.

token, signed App Link entitlements, and self-update channel.

the next launch. The mutable service environment is
{@link HostAppApi.toggleServiceEnv}. It is **not** the
lxapp publish channel (`LxAppReleaseType`:
`'release' | 'draft'`). Default channel is `release` and can be
overridden when opening an lxapp.

types.name: NoLifecycleTypos
types.summary: Applied to the custom half of an `App` config.
types.description:
Applied to the custom half of an `App` config. `onload` and `onShow`
are one keystroke apart from real hooks and the runtime would simply never
call the misspelling, so the closest case-insensitive match is rejected.
Genuinely different names stay ordinary methods.

types.name: NotificationApi
types.summary: Local notifications as a resume affordance.
types.description:
Local notifications as a resume affordance.
Without `capabilities.notifications`, or where the platform has no
local API, every call fails `E_NOT_SUPPORTED`; ask
`lx.supports('app.notification')` first.
Declaring the capability never prompts; permission runs on
`requestPermission()` or the first `show()` that reaches the OS.
Every lxapp may call it. The Control app speaks for the product; a
guest lxapp speaks only for itself: its ids are its own (it cannot
replace or cancel another app's), a tap can only open itself, it
may hold 32 live notifications, and it may cause at most one
permission prompt per launch, only while it is open on screen.

fields.name: getPermission
fields.summary: Read the current permission without prompting.
fields.description:
Read the current permission without prompting. `'default'` means the
user has not been asked yet.

fields.name: requestPermission
fields.summary: Ask for notification permission.
fields.description:
Ask for notification permission. Prompts where the OS has a prompt and
the user has not answered; otherwise reports the current setting.
Rejects when the prompt is left unanswered.

fields.name: show
fields.type: (options: { id?: string; title: string; body?: string; target?: HostTarget; schedule?: { at: number; } | { delayMs: number; }; silent?: boolean; }) => Promise<{ id: string; status: "posted" | "scheduled" | "suppressed"; }>
fields.summary: Post a local notification now or at `schedule`, replacing any under the same `id`.
fields.description:
Post a local notification now or at `schedule`, replacing any under the same `id`.
An invalid target, unknown page or route, or an unconfigured host rejects here,
before anything is posted. A tap whose target is gone by then brings the
product forward and says it is unavailable.

throws.when: A guest lxapp's `target` names anything but itself.

fields.name: cancel

fields.description:

fields.name: cancelAll

fields.description:

lxapp's call removes only its own.

payload.

Rejects when scanning fails or the host returns an invalid payload.

fields.name: actionSheet
fields.summary: Shows a list of actions.
fields.description:
Shows a list of actions.
Resolves `{ status: 'ok', id }` when the user selects an item; `id` identifies the selected item. Resolves `{ status: 'canceled' }` only when the
user dismisses the sheet. Rejects when presentation fails or the host returns
an invalid selection.

fields.name: alert
fields.summary: Acknowledgement-only dialog.
fields.description: Acknowledgement-only dialog. Resolves when the user dismisses it.

fields.name: confirm
fields.summary: Ask a yes/no question.
fields.description: Ask a yes/no question. Dismissal resolves false; presentation failure rejects.

fields.name: toast
fields.summary: Show a short message over the page.
fields.description: Show a short message over the page. Returns at once; a newer toast replaces it.

types.name: UpdateRecipe
types.summary: A recipe changes the draft in place.
types.description:
A recipe changes the draft in place. What it returns is ignored, so
`d => d.list.push(x)` is fine; a promise, or a new object shaped like the
data, is refused.

types.name: UploadOptions
types.summary: Upload options.
types.description:
Upload options. The file streams from disk, so the size ceiling is
the remote's, not memory.
`bodyMode` picks the body shape, and with it which of the other
fields apply:
- `multipart` (default) wraps the file in a `multipart/form-data`
envelope beside the `formData` text fields — what an ordinary form
endpoint parses. `name`, `fileName`, and `formData` describe that
envelope. `formData`, when present, must contain at least one field.
- `raw` sends the file bytes as the entire body. Presigned
object-storage URLs (S3, OSS, Azure Blob) need this: a multipart
envelope would be stored verbatim as the object's contents,
boundary lines and all. `name`, `formData`, and `fileName` are
then rejected rather than silently dropped.
types.text: { file: string; method?: 'POST' | 'PUT' | 'PATCH'; headers?: Record<string, string>; timeoutMs?: number; mimeType?: string; signal?: AbortSignal; } & ({ bodyMode?: 'multipart'; name?: string; formData?: Record<string, string>; fileName?: string; } | { bodyMode: 'raw'; name?: never; formData?: never; fileName?: never; })

types.name: UploadProgressEvent
types.text: { kind: 'progress' | 'canceled'; uploadedBytes?: number; totalBytes?: number; progress?: number; } | { kind: 'completed'; uploadedBytes?: number; totalBytes?: number; progress?: number; result: UploadResult; }

fields.name: statusCode
fields.summary: HTTP status code returned by the server.
fields.description: HTTP status code returned by the server.

fields.name: data
fields.summary: Response body decoded as UTF-8 text.
fields.description: Response body decoded as UTF-8 text.

fields.name: cancel
fields.summary: Requests cancellation.
fields.description: Requests cancellation. Await result to observe the terminal outcome.

fields.name: result
fields.summary: Settles once with the outcome.
fields.description: Settles once with the outcome.

fields.name: progress
fields.summary: Progress events while it runs; ends when it finishes.
fields.description: Progress events while it runs; ends when it finishes.

fields.name: kind
fields.summary: Bytes were sent, or the upload was canceled.
fields.description: Bytes were sent, or the upload was canceled.

fields.name: uploadedBytes
fields.summary: Bytes handed to the socket so far, envelope included under `multipart`.
fields.description: Bytes handed to the socket so far, envelope included under `multipart`.

fields.name: totalBytes
fields.summary: Bytes the whole request body will carry.
fields.description:
Bytes the whole request body will carry. Equals the file size under
`bodyMode: 'raw'`; under `multipart` it also covers the envelope, so it
runs slightly above the file size.

fields.name: progress
fields.summary: `uploadedBytes / totalBytes`, absent while the total is unknown or zero.
fields.description: `uploadedBytes / totalBytes`, absent while the total is unknown or zero.

types.name: WindowChrome
types.summary: Window decoration.
types.description:
Window decoration. `system` is the standard title bar. `full`
extends the page to the window edge while keeping the system
minimize, maximize, resize, and drag affordances — the runtime owns
a native drag strip across the top and publishes its height as
`topInset` on the page-chrome snapshot, so a page that does nothing
to opt in still cannot trap the user.
